notes: rust-stdlib-crypto over the reviewed p224, p256, p384, p521 and ecdsa crates. Embedding (PrivateKey embeds PublicKey, PublicKey embeds elliptic.Curve) is a public field plus Deref; the *big.Int fields are bigint::Int. Randomized signing is the hedged RFC 6979 variant with entropy from crypto/rand, the reader arguments are ignored like Go 1.26+ without GODEBUG=cryptocustomrand=1, and signing with no reader is deterministic RFC 6979 over the hash named by the options, as in Go. Keys on a custom elliptic.CurveParams can be held but signing and verifying return an error (Go's math/big fallback is a first-party ECDSA implementation, ADR 0003). PrivateKey implements crypto::Signer; PKIX, PKCS #8 and SEC 1 DER hooks serve x509.

GenerateKey.note: NIST curves only; a custom CurveParams returns an error where Go uses its generic implementation; Go's reader argument becomes `ecdsa::generate_key_with_rng`, which takes the reader first; the plain function uses the system source (ADR 0005). Go 1.26+ ignores the reader unless GODEBUG=cryptocustomrand=1.

PrivateKey.Equal.note: takes &dyn Any in place of crypto.PrivateKey

PrivateKey.Sign.note: rand and opts are optional (Go passes nil); the crypto::Signer implementation is the same method; sign is Go's Sign(nil, ...) (deterministic RFC 6979); sign_with_rng is Sign(rng, ...) (hedged, reader ignored like Go 1.26+ unless GODEBUG=cryptocustomrand=1)

PublicKey.Equal.note: takes &dyn Any in place of crypto.PublicKey

Sign.note: NIST curves only, as GenerateKey; Go's reader argument becomes `ecdsa::sign_with_rng`, which takes the reader first; the plain function uses the system source (ADR 0005). Go 1.26+ ignores the reader unless GODEBUG=cryptocustomrand=1.

SignASN1.note: NIST curves only, as GenerateKey; Go's reader argument becomes `ecdsa::sign_asn1_with_rng`, which takes the reader first; the plain function uses the system source (ADR 0005). Go 1.26+ ignores the reader unless GODEBUG=cryptocustomrand=1.

Verify.note: NIST curves only: false for a custom CurveParams

VerifyASN1.note: NIST curves only: false for a custom CurveParams
